test_self_cycle: test that a pybind11 object with a self-referential cycle is garbage collected correctly
test_indirect_cycle: test that a pybind11 object with an indirect reference cycle via a list is garbage collected
run_gc_tester_fixture: run the gc_tester pytest fixture to verify objects are garbage collected after gc.collect
test_OwnsPythonObjects: test the pybind11 custom_type_setup OwnsPythonObjects class for proper garbage collection behavior
review_gc_tester: review the gc_tester fixture that uses weakref to verify objects are fully garbage collected
